name: Willow Creek Counseling
hoursText: Monday-Thursday: 9am to 8pm, Friday: 9am to 3pm, Saturday: by appointment only, Sunday: closed

profile.clinicians: Dana (LCSW) - adults, anxiety and life transitions, EMDR-trained. Marcus (LMFT) - couples and families. Rosa (LMHC) - teens ages 13-17 and young adults; sees clients in English and Spanish. Matching happens after the free consultation.
profile.insurance: In network with Anthem, CareSource, and UnitedHealthcare/Optum. Out of network for all other plans: we provide a monthly superbill you can submit for possible reimbursement. We do not accept Medicare. Payment by card (HSA/FSA cards welcome); card kept on file through our secure client portal.
profile.fees: Standard individual session (50 min) $140; couples and family sessions (50 min) $160; first sessions run longer and cost a bit more. A limited number of sliding-scale spots ($70-$120) are available for individual therapy - ask during the free consultation.
profile.consultation: Free 15-minute phone or video call with one of our clinicians. We call you at the time you book. It's a chance to ask questions and see if we're a good fit - not a therapy session.
profile.telehealth: Telehealth by secure video for clients located in Indiana at the time of the session. Office is on the 4th floor, elevator access, free parking in the surface lot; the waiting room is shared with no sign-in sheet.
profile.cancellation: Please cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours ahead. Late cancellations and no-shows are charged the full session fee (insurance doesn't cover missed sessions). The free consultation has no fee if you need to move it.
profile.policies: We see clients ages 13 and up; a parent or guardian must book and consent for anyone under 18. We don't prescribe medication or provide psychological testing, custody evaluations, or court-ordered services. Records and release-of-information requests go through the office manager and need a signed form. We are not a crisis service: in an emergency call or text 988, or call 911.
